summary: Pacing night: our own timelines show the October hits were spoken at 203-240 words a minute and the 9-10 Nov Shorts at 146-172, so I proposed an experiment to go back to that pace. Added 5 big-money topics with famous names and sourced figures (Ronaldo, IPL, Taylor Swift, Berkshire's cash, Ohtani), and told the owner why titles stopped naming Elon.
why: Shorts at 200+ wpm have a median of 237 views in 48 h (n=19) against 31 at 175-200 wpm (n=14). The variant system dropped name/figure titles on a comparison confounded by length: within 20-27 s, name/figure titles have a median of 908 views (n=5).

findings.title: Our hits were spoken much faster
findings.detail: Every 700+ view Short but one: 203-240 wpm at voice speed 1.4; the Shorts of 9-10 Nov: 146-172 wpm at 1.2. Proposed as an experiment (shorts-voice-back-to-october-pace).

findings.title: Titles hide famous names because of the variant system
findings.detail: title: plain promoted on 6 Nov (n=4); confounded by length. Owner notification with steps.

findings.title: Too many highlight actions
findings.detail: Glow, shake, grow and tag are 40-71% of the actions in the 10 Nov Shorts; actions-that-change-things raised to high.

findings.title: IPL money: a 17M-view local reference, and retention lists due this month

findings.detail: No change for the Pro-plan routines.
